scope: evidence_derived_v3 implementation and verification files only
purpose: Preserve the original registered implementation hashes while separately freezing the final post-search implementation used for downstream coding, operationalization, selection, and audit.
constraints: The original source_snapshots row and original SHA-256 must never be overwritten or deleted.
The final bytes must be copied to a content-addressed immutable path and registered under a new versioned source ID.
The observed mutable-path hash must equal the registered final immutable snapshot hash at audit time.
The supersession must be exported in the deterministic audit payload and evidence tables.
No frozen literature, term, search-frame, screening, indicator-evidence, or reviewer-decision input is authorized to change.
Any further change to a superseded mutable path invalidates completion until a new explicit version is created.
rationale: The v3 workflow continued to add downstream validation, independent-review import guards, round-12 reporting disclosure, deterministic feature materialization, and audit checks after the first implementation snapshots had been registered. Treating those legitimate downstream implementation versions as silent rebases would be false; retaining both hashes with an explicit version edge is auditable.
